events.event: Komdigi, at a Jakarta discussion, asked platforms to label AI-generated content and be transparent about AI agents after the Threads account @IbuAsihLaundry went viral as a suspected AI bot that pro-Prabowo/MBG posts.
events.key_numbers: Komdigi session 22 Oct 2026 · account allegedly named model 'Muse Spark' (Meta) and posted an Anthropic API-credit error · Komdigi: bot use alone is not a violation · expert Alfons Tanujaya: neat writing/high posting frequency does not prove AI
events.why_it_matters: Shows how to spot AI-run political accounts and what the state wants platforms to do about them.
events.spreading_evidence: Katadata terpopuler (2 Ibu Asih Laundry items)

events.event: Komdigi asked Meta to clarify after Meta.ai told users that karhutla content was restricted at Komdigi's request; Komdigi says it does not restrict or shadowban karhutla content.
events.key_numbers: Komdigi remarks 22 Oct, reported 23 Oct 2026 · Menkomdigi denial video 21 Oct · Meta had not replied at publication · cites Surat Edaran Menkomdigi 9/2023 on AI ethics · draft Perpres on AI ethics and National AI Roadmap 2026-2029 in preparation
events.why_it_matters: A chatbot's claim that the government is hiding haze content spread widely; the fact is the ministry denies it and Meta is silent.
events.spreading_evidence: Covered by detik, Katadata, CNN Indonesia, CNBC

events.event: The PHP2Shell flaw disrupted sites worldwide as operators took pages offline to patch, including Japan's ANA, JR West and MUFG, several European government sites and Wikimedia systems; in Indonesia the Ministry of Industry (Kemenperin) temporarily shut its site.
events.key_numbers: 2 critical PHP flaws · PHP runs ~70% of websites · Wiz compares impact to Heartbleed (2014) · advisory 21 Oct, outages 22-23 Oct 2026 · Kemenperin shutdown per Bisnis headline 24 Oct (body not read)
events.why_it_matters: A single bug in the software behind most websites forced banks, airlines and ministries offline, and Indonesian government sites are among the unpatched.
events.spreading_evidence: Katadata terpopuler (3 PHP2Shell items); CNBC tech headlines

events.event: Counterpoint Research data reported by Bisnis.com show global PC shipments fell 21% y/y in Q3 2026 because DRAM and NAND memory costs pushed laptop prices up and buyers delayed purchases.
events.key_numbers: 57 million units in Q3 2026 (-21% y/y) · Lenovo 15 m (26.3%) · HP 10.3 m (18.1%) · Dell 7.6 m (13.3%) · Apple ~5.6 m laptops (-11%, 9.8% share) · Asus 5.2 m (+19.4% q/q) · Counterpoint sees Q4 down again, up to -27% for full 2026, flat 2027
events.why_it_matters: Laptops and gadgets are getting pricier because memory chips cost more, and it is projected to last into 2027.

events.event: Kemenekraf games director Luat Sihombing said rising chip and RAM prices are squeezing Indonesia's game industry and that the ministry is preparing incentives and a revision of Perpres 19/2024.
events.key_numbers: Chip and RAM prices rising for 2 years · games could add up to US$3.3 bn (~Rp59 T) to GDP by 2030 · ~476,600 jobs by 2030 vs ~257,400 now (Tencent/Access Partnership white paper) · stated at WCCE 2026, 22 Oct
events.why_it_matters: The memory-chip price rise is hitting game makers as well as laptop buyers.

events.event: Malaysia bars civil servants from using Waze on official matters over fears that data could leak to Israel, per detik and CNBC Indonesia.
events.key_numbers: Report dated 24 Oct 2026 · applies to ASN/PNS · reason: data-leak concern (Israel link) as reported
events.why_it_matters: Raises the question of which everyday map and chat apps governments trust with location data.
